class.name: Anticheat
class.brief_description: Loads first-party anticheat runtimes next to the executable and forwards ticks.
class.description: The Anticheat singleton dynamically loads [code]bzcl[/code] (and dedicated [code]bzsv[/code]/[code]bzgb[/code]) from the executable directory. If the library is missing, [method is_available] is [code]false[/code]. Game scripts must not configure detectors or ops credentials.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the private client runtime loaded and required symbols bound.

method.name: get_server_available
method.description: Dedicated server only. Returns [code]true[/code] when [code]bzsv[/code] and [code]bzgb[/code] loaded.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Calls [code]BZCL_Init[/code]. Returns 0 on success.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the loaded runtime.

method.name: sv_initialize
method.description: Dedicated server: calls [code]BZSV_Init[/code] without connecting ops. Returns 0 on success.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful client [method initialize].

method.name: is_server_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method sv_initialize].

method.name: tick
method.description: Forwards a tick to the private runtime. 0 means unbounded.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the client runtime is initialized and enabled.

method.name: submit_packet
method.description: Forwards an integrity tunnel blob from the net layer.

method.name: submit_command
method.description: Optional debug command. Do not use in production.

method.name: ops_connect
method.description: Dedicated server: connect [code]bzgb[/code] using ProjectSettings and [code]BLAZIUM_AC_API_KEY[/code] for SaaS. Internal mode requires [code]anticheat/ops/license_path[/code] unless [code]BLAZIUM_AC_DEV=1[/code].

method.name: is_ops_connected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [code]bzgb[/code] is connected after [method ops_connect].

method.name: sv_on_packet
method.description: Dedicated server: forwards a client integrity blob to [code]bzsv[/code].

method.name: sv_client_join
method.description: Dedicated server: starts the integrity hello for a client slot.

method.name: sv_drop_client
method.description: Dedicated server: drop an integrity slot and emit [signal server_drop_client].

method.name: bind_player
method.description: Maps a game account id to a dedicated client slot so ops Kick can emit [signal server_drop_client].

method.name: unbind_player
method.description: Clears the account mapping for a client slot.

method.name: player_client_index
method.description: Returns the bound client slot, or [code]-1[/code] if the player is not mapped.

method.name: apply_ops_line
method.description: Applies one ops JSONL action: Kick/KickMsg if mapped, Message/GlobalMessage/Kill as signals, screenshot upload or [signal ops_screenshot_request] on dedicated, Teleport as [signal ops_teleport]. Always emits [signal ops_action].

method.name: gb_send
method.description: Dedicated server: send a JSONL line to ops after [method ops_connect].

signal.name: ops_action
signal.description: Raw ops JSONL from [code]bzgb[/code]. Named actions are also handled as documented on [method apply_ops_line].

signal.name: ops_teleport
signal.description: Dedicated server: Teleport action. The host must move the player; the module does not.

signal.name: ops_message
signal.description: Dedicated server: deliver a toast or chat line to one player. The host must show it.

signal.name: ops_global_message
signal.description: Dedicated server: broadcast a toast or chat line. The host must show it.

signal.name: ops_kill
signal.description: Dedicated server: force death on that player. The host must apply HP/death.

signal.name: ops_screenshot_request
signal.description: Dedicated server: ask that client's viewport for a PNG. Do not capture the dedicated process.
